titulo: Staff Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
descripcion: - Hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering using Python, including developing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade ML models, for 5+ years. - Proven experience with gradient boosting algorithms (XGBoost, CatBoost, or LightGBM), including hyperparameter tuning, feature importance analysis, and advanced model evaluation. - Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery, including complex feature engineering queries, scheduled data transformations, and data validation. - Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining ML workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud Run, Airflow/Composer, Vertex AI, and Pub/Sub. - Solid understanding of model calibration, business-oriented loss functions, and the impact of prediction errors on downstream optimization systems. - Practical experience integrating ML model outputs with external systems through APIs, such as advertising platforms, recommendation engines, pricing systems, or bidding systems. Strongly preferred: - Experience in e-commerce or Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) environments, particularly customer lifetime value (LTV) prediction, purchase forecasting, churn modeling, or customer segmentation. - Familiarity with probabilistic customer models (BG/NBD, Gamma-Gamma, or similar frameworks) or strong foundations in Bayesian statistics. - Experience with advertising platform integrations, including Google Ads API (ConversionUploadService, Enhanced Conversions), Meta Conversions API (CAPI), or similar server-side event tracking systems. - Knowledge of identity resolution and entity matching techniques, including graph-based identity stitching, probabilistic matching, or cross-device identity resolution. - Level of English – from Upper-Intermediate and above. - Building and maintaining predictive Lifetime Value (pLTV) models using XGBoost, CatBoost, and BG/NBD within a tiered scoring architecture, routing users into appropriate model tiers based on data availability and observability rather than applying a one-size-fits-all regression approach. - Designing, implementing, and maintaining model calibration layers to transform raw predictions into platform-ready values, incorporating haircut scalars, linear, logarithmic, and rank-based normalization, and asymmetric loss functions that penalize overestimating low-value customers more heavily than underestimating high-value customers. - Owning feature engineering processes in BigQuery, developing and maintaining Gold-layer feature tables from cleaned Silver-layer data, including RFM metrics, behavioral embeddings, category affinity, and purchase velocity. - Ensuring feature quality and reliability by evaluating data completeness, monitoring missing-value rates, and excluding features with high missing rates among new users rather than relying on imputation. - Monitoring model drift and distribution shifts, implementing residual logging, comparing pre- and post-signal deployment cohorts, and identifying causal contamination in retraining datasets resulting from the model's influence on user acquisition. - Maintaining and improving batch Union-Find identity resolution algorithms in BigQuery, connecting GA4 behavioral identifiers with Shopify transactional identifiers and optimizing identity match rates to improve signal quality. - Developing and maintaining production-grade Python applications running on Google Cloud Run Jobs, orchestrating workflows through Apache Airflow, and ensuring reliable delivery of ML-generated signals to advertising platforms. - Implementing and maintaining automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, idempotent processing, and dry-run safety mechanisms to ensure production stability, prevent costly errors, and protect client advertising performance.
